mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT bom.INVCODE FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT bom INNER JOIN ( SELECT INVCODE, MAX(HVERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT GROUP BY INVCODE ) latest ON bom.INVCODE = latest.INVCODE AND bom.HVERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION ) m
WHERE m.INVCODE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT inv_code, inv_name, version, org_name, body_code, 0 AS child_count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT bom.INVCODE AS inv_code, bom.INVNAME AS inv_name, bom.HVERSION AS version, bom.ORGNAME AS org_name, bom.BODYCODE AS body_code FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT bom WHERE bom.INVCODE = #{invCode} ) m

SELECT bom.INVCODE_B AS child_code, bom.INVNAME_B AS child_name, bom.MATERIALSPEC1 AS material_spec, bom.MAKEFACTORY1 AS make_factory, bom.NASSITEMNUM AS child_qty, bom.VNOTE AS child_note, bom.VREPLACEINDEX AS replace_priority, bom.INVCODE_TD AS alt_code, bom.INVNAME_TD AS alt_name, bom.MATERIALSPEC2 AS alt_spec, bom.MAKEFACTORY2 AS alt_factory, bom.NASSITEMNUM2 AS alt_qty, bom.BDELIVER AS is_deliver, bom.HBDEFAULT AS is_default, bom.NAME AS main_status, bom.D3NAME AS alt_status, bom.D4NAME AS main_rhos_status, bom.D5NAME AS alt_rhos_status, bom.M2DEF17 AS admit_note FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT bom INNER JOIN ( SELECT INVCODE, INVCODE_B, MAX(HVERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT WHERE INVCODE = #{parentCode} GROUP BY INVCODE, INVCODE_B ) latest ON bom.INVCODE = latest.INVCODE AND bom.INVCODE_B = latest.INVCODE_B AND bom.HVERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE bom.INVCODE = #{parentCode} ORDER BY bom.INVCODE_B

SELECT child.INVCODE_B AS code, child.INVNAME_B AS name, child.MATERIALSPEC1 AS spec, child.NASSITEMNUM AS qty, child.HVERSION AS version, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT sub WHERE sub.INVCODE = child.INVCODE_B AND ROWNUM = 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_children FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT child INNER JOIN ( SELECT INVCODE, INVCODE_B, MAX(HVERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT WHERE INVCODE = #{parentCode} GROUP BY INVCODE, INVCODE_B ) latest ON child.INVCODE = latest.INVCODE AND child.INVCODE_B = latest.INVCODE_B AND child.HVERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE child.INVCODE = #{parentCode} ORDER BY child.INVCODE_B

SELECT bom.INVCODE AS parent_code, bom.INVNAME AS parent_name, bom.INVCODE_B AS child_code, bom.INVNAME_B AS child_name, bom.HVERSION AS version, bom.HNASSPARENTNUM AS parent_qty, bom.CBEGINPERIOD AS effective_date, bom.MATERIALSPEC1 AS material_spec, bom.MAKEFACTORY1 AS make_factory, bom.NASSITEMNUM AS child_qty, bom.VNOTE AS child_note, bom.VREPLACEINDEX AS replace_priority, bom.INVCODE_TD AS alt_code, bom.INVNAME_TD AS alt_name, bom.MATERIALSPEC2 AS alt_spec, bom.MAKEFACTORY2 AS alt_factory, bom.NASSITEMNUM2 AS alt_qty, bom.BDELIVER AS is_deliver, bom.HBDEFAULT AS is_default, bom.NAME AS main_status, bom.D3NAME AS alt_status, bom.D4NAME AS main_rhos_status, bom.D5NAME AS alt_rhos_status, bom.M2DEF17 AS admit_note, bom.ORGNAME AS org_name, bom.BODYCODE AS body_code FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT bom INNER JOIN ( SELECT INVCODE, INVCODE_B, MAX(HVERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM V_BOM_OUTPUT GROUP BY INVCODE, INVCODE_B ) latest ON bom.INVCODE = latest.INVCODE AND bom.INVCODE_B = latest.INVCODE_B AND bom.HVERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION ORDER BY bom.INVCODE, bom.INVCODE_B
